laws_measured: a frozen index is not an action, and neither is a frozen label: the page blanks its own text on the first press and renumbers its elements, so identity is positional and the ledger must be written positionally too
where a thing is counts as observed state: a text-only fingerprint read a page that had become a different arrangement of blank rects as unchanged
a submenu header is hovered, not clicked
a widget's orientation is its track's, not its handle's; vertical sliders invert
never act on half an instruction

next_step: Attach the measured verdict budget to every lesson admission: a lesson admitted against a suite carries that suite's rejection rate and survivor list, so permanence is bounded by what the verdict could distinguish.

obs_goal.real_outcome: An arm with no experience of any page solved 39 of 130 real computer-use pages (0.300) and 58.2% of the 67 it could parse, read no reward, searched nothing, and used no external model. It refused 63 pages with a typed reason instead of guessing, and nothing earned partial credit without succeeding. Of its 28 acted failures only 12 are execution errors; 16 name something the page never shows as an element (a calendar, a colour region, prose, a prefix family) or need the environment's hidden state.

obs_solution.solution: A contract compiler plus an execution arm that resolves every action against the live page: positional identity for targets whose text the page erases, geometry as observed state, hover for submenu headers, track orientation for sliders, arrows for spinners, and refusal instead of half-execution.
obs_solution.why_this_and_not_something_else: Experience cannot supply a name the DOM does not contain, so the work belongs in observation and contract coverage.
